523306: _The city buzzes with life as the lanterns burn through the night. Amidst the fleeting shifts of light and show, one glimpses hidden sentiments beneath smiling faces. Countless scenes unfold, laughter fills the streets, and year after year, people celebrate auspicious moments._
523307: _The place where Chromafaces live. When the market quiets down, there may be a merchant heading home in the moonlight, an old woman walking by the river, and a child shouting under the eaves. So many sights of joy and sorrow. So many gatherings and partings. All are a slice of real life._
523308: _A prison built by the Jiuhua Bureau. It sits far away from the bustling city and his heavily guarded._
523309: _Once known by the name "Spirit Lots," it is now passed from mouth to mouth as the "Token Hall." The chest holds thousands of fates. Each token within records a lifetime of stories. For over a century, the cycle has repeated, waiting for the full moon._
523310: _The hotpot house in Cai Ye. In a bubbling pot, savor myriad flavors and embrace a multitude of encounters. As the saying goes--through the rise and fall of life's tastes, every pot bubbles, and every pot smells divine!_
523311: _The entrance to the Kongming Gorge. Cries of monsters can be often heard, scaring off anyone who hears them. Thus, few Chromafaces have dared enter. What lies within remains a secret scarcely known._
523312: _A flower field that leads deeper into the valley. Its dazzling blooms can be mistaken for snow, yet beneath their brilliance, do they still echo the cries of sorrow that have lingered for a century?_
523313: _The place where Echowood is located. Where did it come from? Why does it exist? How has it lived this long? No one knows. The sorrowful cries, as well as its broken form, pain the Chromafaces._
523314: _An obscure spring in the depths of the Kongming Gorge. The water is clear and can be used as a mirror. Is the face in the reflection that of a human or a Chromaface? What is the difference?_
523315: _The Jiuhua Pavilion's entrance, can only be reached via the Mooncradle Float. The pavilion stands among the stars and neighbors the moon. Heavenly music and joyous feasts fill its halls, bit its drapes hide great sorrow._
523316: _The most lively place in the Jiuhua Pavilion. The sound of treasure chests opening and closing persists throughout the night as Fortune Jade change hands between Chromafaces, their flush red cheeks illuminated by the silk lanterns. It doesn't matter if they win or lose--they're in for the thrill!_
523317: _The float management area of Cai Ye. Ride the wind, drive through the mist, soar about the clouds--take in the mountains, waters, and boundless freedom. From here, you can summon a float to the station._
523318:
**Prerequisite:** Start "[Hotpot Rescue](#loc=534996)"
